title: WAFBypass Signature Schema v1
description: Declarative WAF detection signature format. Replaces Python plugin files with auditable YAML rules.

product.description: WAF product name (equivalent to __product__ in Python plugins)

tags.description: Classification tags (cdn, cloud, hardware, opensource, chinese, etc.)

detection.description: Detection rules. At least one sub-key must be present.

header_presence.description: Header names that trigger detection when non-empty (e.g. CF-RAY)

patterns.description: Regex patterns matched against specified fields

status_rules.description: Conditional rules that only apply for specific HTTP status codes

match_all_headers.description: If true, match patterns against ALL header keys and values

conditional.description: Multi-step rules: only check patterns if a prerequisite header is present

tamper_hints.description: Recommended bypass technique families for AdaptiveRanker

last_verified.description: Date this signature was last verified against a live target

fields.description: Fields to match against: body, server, set-cookie, cookie, x-powered-by, via, x-cache, location, expect-ct, all_headers, or any custom header name (lowercase)

flags.description: Regex flags: i=ignorecase, m=multiline, s=dotall. Combined as string.

negate.description: If true, pattern must NOT match for detection to trigger

field.description: Field to search in (same as pattern fields, singular)

case_sensitive.description: Whether the contains check is case-sensitive

status.description: HTTP status codes that trigger this rule

patterns.description: Patterns to check only when status matches

contains.description: Contains checks only when status matches

if_header.description: Header name that must be non-empty for patterns to be checked

patterns.description: Patterns to check only when if_header is present
